problem: Specialized domains have abundant unlabeled images but few task labels and limited client compute.
contribution: SDAPT adapts a shared vision foundation model to unlabeled domain images. Frozen client layers keep local computation light; server-side self-distillation learns a common representation, then each client trains its own task head.
reading_guide: Compare label budgets, adaptation costs and individual task gains separately.

diagram.title: Adapt once, train local heads
diagram.description: SDAPT adapts a shared vision foundation model to unlabeled domain images. Frozen client layers keep local computation light; server-side self-distillation learns a common representation, then each client trains its own task head.

stages.title: Frozen clients
stages.detail: Frozen client layers process two global and eight local image crops. Raw images remain local; CLS and patch tokens are uploaded.

stages.title: Self-distillation
stages.detail: Combine all client features into one batch. Train the student with DINO, iBOT and KoLeo, update an EMA teacher, and return no gradients to frozen clients.

stages.title: Local task heads
stages.detail: Freeze the adapted teacher backbone. Return representations to each client, which trains a task-specific head using its own labels.

diagram.footnote: Raw images and labels stay local; the shared backbone is frozen during task-head training.

limitations: Evaluation uses IID partitions and classification tasks.
Reported costs are feature uplink and client computation during adaptation; server work is excluded.
Raw-data locality is not a formal privacy guarantee.
takeaways: Across nine 4-, 8- and 16-shot settings, SDAPT improves over direct fine-tuning by 7.4 percentage points on average.
At 16 shots, SDAPT gains 14.1 points on fMoW, 10.8 on QuickDraw and 6.6 AUROC points on CheXpert over the no-DAPT baseline; it exceeds MocoSFL in all three.
One CheXpert-adapted backbone improves mean AUROC from 77.41 to 80.68 across eight labels, with gains on six; larger adaptation budgets favor SDAPT while MocoSFL can be stronger at low budgets.
